name: publicWeb_getReportContext
description: What the SendRunCountsReport Azure Function needs before a web member's emailed run-counts report (E9.F7.S17, the app's floating-action-button report): the INTERNAL kennel id, the kennel's name, the caller's display name and email address — none of which the member web session holds, since it only carries public ids. Resolving them server-side keeps the internal id and the address out of the browser. Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 118, @param NULL); the hasher is the token's user. No permission gate. Read-only.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: The browser's HC.Device id (the web member session). No SQL default.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived token signed for this SP (ValidateAppAuth spNumber 118, @param NULL). No SQL default.

parameters.name: publicKennelId
parameters.description: The kennel; NULL for the all-kennels report, signalled to the function as an empty GUID KennelId and the name 'All kennels'.

rowsets.name: AuthErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: On a ValidateAppAuth failure: { success = 0, errorCode, errorType } then the detail at index 1; the SP RETURNs.
Error detail after the AuthErrorEnvelope (errorId, errorType, errorCode, errorTitle, errorUserMessage, errorProc).

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: On success: { success = 1, errorCode = NULL, errorType = NULL }.

rowsets.name: ReportContext
rowsets.description: On success: one row for the caller (zero rows when the hasher row is Removed or Removed IS NULL — the WHERE is h.Removed = 0).

columns.name: KennelId
columns.description: Kennel.id; '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' for all kennels — AND when @publicKennelId matches no live kennel (see codeSmells).

columns.name: EmailAddress
columns.description: Hasher.Email — may be a generated address (HC6.IsGeneratedEmail); the API mailer refuses those.

sideEffects: INSERT HC.ErrorLog ('<web>', userId, deviceId) then THROW in the CATCH. ValidateAppAuth logs its own failures.

codeSmells.detail: @deviceId and @accessToken have no SQL default (line 18). A caller that omits one is refused by SQL Server before the procedure runs — an empty 500 with no HC.ErrorLog row (CLAUDE.md 'SP parameter with NO default'). The Next.js client always sends them, so this is latent.

codeSmells.issue: Unknown kennel silently becomes the all-kennels report
codeSmells.detail: Lines 44-50: @kennelId / @kennelName start as the empty GUID / 'All kennels' and are only overwritten when the kennel is found. A wrong, deleted or removed @publicKennelId therefore returns the all-kennels context with success = 1 instead of an error, and the member is emailed a different report from the one they asked for.

codeSmells.issue: Removed IS NULL hasher returns no row
codeSmells.detail: Hasher.Removed is nullable; line 60 'h.Removed = 0' drops a NULL row, leaving success = 1 with an empty rowset 1 — the caller gets no context and no error.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
